intro: Are you a small business owner or an entrepreneur looking for funds to grow your business? 🤔 The Pradhan Mantri MUDRA (Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency) Yojana, also known as PM Mudra Loan, is a government-backed scheme that provides loans to non-corporate, non-farm sector income-generating activities 🌟. In this article, we will guide you through the process of applying for a PM Mudra Loan online in 2026 📆. So, let's get started and explore the world of PM Mudra Loan 🚀

sections.heading: 📈 Introduction to PM Mudra Loan
sections.content: The PM Mudra Loan scheme was launched in 2015 by the Government of India to promote entrepreneurship and job creation in the country 🌟. The scheme provides loans up to ₹10 lakhs to non-corporate, non-farm sector income-generating activities, such as small businesses, artisans, and self-employed individuals 📊. The loan is provided by Public Sector Banks, Private Sector Banks, Regional Rural Banks, and Microfinance Institutions 🏦. The interest rate on PM Mudra Loan varies from 8.5% to 12.5% per annum, depending on the lender and the loan amount 💸.

sections.heading: 📝 Eligibility Criteria for PM Mudra Loan
sections.content: To be eligible for a PM Mudra Loan, you must meet the following criteria 📝: you must be a citizen of India, your business must be located in India, you must have a valid business plan, and you must have a good credit score 📈. Additionally, you must not have any pending loans or credit card dues 🚫. The eligibility criteria may vary depending on the lender and the loan amount, so it's essential to check with the lender before applying 📊.

sections.heading: 📁 Required Documents for PM Mudra Loan
sections.content: To apply for a PM Mudra Loan, you will need to provide the following documents 📁: identity proof (Aadhaar card, PAN card, or passport), address proof (utility bills, rent agreement, or passport), business proof (business registration certificate, GST certificate, or shop act license), and income proof (ITR, balance sheet, or profit and loss account) 📊. You may also need to provide additional documents, such as a business plan, loan application form, and passport-sized photographs 📸.

sections.heading: 📈 Step-by-Step Online Application Process for PM Mudra Loan
sections.content: To apply for a PM Mudra Loan online, follow these steps 📈: visit the official website of the lender or the PM Mudra Loan portal, click on the 'Apply Now' button, fill in the online application form with your personal and business details, upload the required documents, and submit the application form 📊. Once you submit the application form, the lender will verify your details and documents, and if everything is in order, the loan will be disbursed to your account 🏦. The online application process is quick and easy, and you can track the status of your application online 📊.

sections.heading: 🏦 Benefits of PM Mudra Loan
sections.content: The PM Mudra Loan scheme offers several benefits to small business owners and entrepreneurs 🌟. The loan is available at a low interest rate, and the repayment tenure is flexible, ranging from 5 to 7 years 📆. The loan can be used for a variety of purposes, such as working capital, equipment purchase, or business expansion 📈. Additionally, the loan is collateral-free, which means you don't need to provide any security to avail the loan 🚫. The PM Mudra Loan scheme also provides a credit guarantee scheme, which covers up to 50% of the loan amount in case of default 🤝.

faqs.q: What is the interest rate on PM Mudra Loan? 🤔
faqs.a: The interest rate on PM Mudra Loan varies from 8.5% to 12.5% per annum, depending on the lender and the loan amount 💸.

faqs.q: What is the repayment tenure of PM Mudra Loan? 📆
faqs.a: The repayment tenure of PM Mudra Loan ranges from 5 to 7 years 📆.

faqs.q: Do I need to provide collateral to avail PM Mudra Loan? 🚫
faqs.a: No, the PM Mudra Loan is collateral-free, which means you don't need to provide any security to avail the loan 🚫.
